questions.text: Can you tell me a little about your hometown?

cueCard.topic: Describe an important change in your life.
cueCard.explain: and explain why this change was important to you.

questions.text: Describe an important change in your life.
questions.say: Thank you. Now, in Part 2, I'm going to give you a topic, and I'd like you to talk about it for one to two minutes. Before you talk, you'll have one minute to think about what you're going to say. You can make some notes if you wish. Here is your topic. Describe an important change in your life. You should say: what the change was; when it happened; how it affected you; and explain why this change was important to you.

questions.text: Was this change easy for the people around you?
questions.say: Thank you. Was this change easy for the people around you?

questions.text: Why are some people afraid of change?
questions.say: Thank you. We've been talking about an important change in your life, and I'd like to discuss with you some more general questions related to this. Let's consider first of all change. Why are some people afraid of change?

questions.text: Do young people find it easier to accept change than older people?
questions.say: Do young people find it easier to accept change than older people?

questions.text: What are the biggest changes in your country in the last twenty years?
questions.say: What are the biggest changes in your country in the last twenty years?

questions.text: What difficulties do people face when they move to a new city?
questions.say: Now let's talk about adapting to new places. What difficulties do people face when they move to a new city?

questions.text: How can people make friends when they move to a new place?
questions.say: How can people make friends when they move to a new place?

questions.text: Is it a good idea for young people to live in another country for a while?
